title: Glob lab
description: Write and fix glob patterns against a list of paths: see the matched files in a tree, which expectations pass, and the regex each glob becomes.
needs: an object with globs ([{ id, pattern, dot, nocase, expect: { path: "match" | "no-match" } }], at least one) and paths (a string with one path per line)

tools.name: setGlobOptions
tools.description: Set a glob's options: dot (wildcards match dotfiles) and nocase.

tools.name: addGlob
tools.description: Add a glob; it gets the next free id (g1, g2, …).

tools.name: reorderGlobs
tools.description: Move a glob to a position (0 is first).

tools.name: setPaths
tools.description: Replace the paths: one string, one path per line.

tools.name: setExpectation
tools.description: Say whether a glob should match a path: match, no-match, or none to clear it.

tools.name: matches
tools.description: The paths a glob matches and doesn't, and each of its expectations with pass or fail.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: The regex picomatch compiles a glob to, with its base directory and whether it is a glob at all.
